svg.title: Classic Metal — compact modular stack
svg.desc: Original beveled surfaces, spectral display, transport, EQ and playlist modules. Modern target sizes and readable labels replace tiny legacy controls.
svg.text: Winamp-inspired modularity, modern targets and explicit labels. Original metal styling; no copied sprites.
STACK ORDER: PLAYER → EQ → PLAYLIST · Minimum logical width: 560 px · No 275 px hit-target constraint
